correctness.rationale: Fresh symbolic algebra verifies \(B^2-4AC=64(u^2+3)^3\), both conjugate cube identities and both displayed sections. The third-summand condition reduces to \(Y^2=X^3+16\); the inspected LMFDB entry 27.a4 has rank zero and torsion \(\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z\), leaving only excluded \(u=\pm1\). Bao's stated criteria then give ranks \((1,2,0)\).
